clauses.scope_note: ODC-By section 9.1: any breach by You automatically terminates this License immediately without notice. This concerns the Database and licensed material. Persons receiving the Database, the whole or a Substantial part of the Contents, Derivative Databases, or the Database as part of a Collective Database from You under this License retain their licenses if their use fully complies with this License or a license granted under section 4.8. Sections 1, 2, 7, 8, 9 and 10 survive termination.
clauses.condition_explanation: licensee_breach_has_terminated_license means You breached a term or condition of the License and the automatic termination has taken effect. downstream_compliant means the recipient's use fully complies with this License or a section 4.8 license. The source does not specify an activity rule for recipients whose licenses survive.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By section 9.2: the Licensor will not terminate Your rights if You are not in breach. This is a protection against Licensor termination, not an independent grant of rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: licensee_not_in_breach means You are not in breach of the License terms. license_rights_not_terminated means no termination under section 9.1 has taken effect.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By section 9.3: the License is granted for the duration of applicable rights in the Database unless terminated under section 9.1.
clauses.condition_explanation: license_rights_active means the License has not been terminated under section 9.1, or rights have been reinstated under section 9.4. applicable_rights_duration means the duration of the rights applicable to the Database.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By section 9.4: cessation of breach reinstates full rights provisionally, subject to permanent termination, through the 60th day after cessation. Rights become permanent on that day unless the Licensor reasonably notifies otherwise. Alternatively, rights become permanent if the Licensor reasonably notified You of the violation, this is the first notice of violation You received from the Licensor, and You cure before 30 days after receipt.
clauses.condition_explanation: breach_ceased means You ceased the breach. reinstatement_provisional_until_day_60_after_cessation means the provisional period runs until the 60th day after cessation. day_60_after_cessation_reached means that day has arrived. licensor_has_not_reasonably_notified_otherwise means no reasonable contrary notification was given. first_notice_of_violation_from_licensor means this is the first violation notice You received from the Licensor. violation_cured_before_30_days_after_notice_receipt means cure occurred prior to 30 days after receipt.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By section 9.5: the Licensor may release the Database under different terms or stop distributing or making it available, but neither action withdraws this License or another license granted or required under it. This License continues in full force unless terminated as stated in section 9.
clauses.condition_explanation: license_rights_not_terminated_under_section_9_1 means rights continue under the License or have been reinstated under section 9.4. A change in licensing terms or cessation of distribution alone does not terminate them.

clauses.scope_note: ODC-By section 10.4: additional rights are granted only if the standard suite of rights under applicable copyright law and Database Rights in the relevant jurisdiction includes rights not otherwise granted under the License. The relevant jurisdiction is where the License terms are sought to be enforced.
clauses.condition_explanation: applicable_jurisdictional_copyright_or_database_rights_include_additional_rights means the applicable standard suite includes additional rights not granted under the License. The text does not identify the jurisdiction or specify which additional rights apply.

coverage_notes: Section 9.4 reinstatement timing and notice pathways are represented as alternatives; the text does not specify a further procedure for permanent termination after a contrary notice.

Section 10.3 states that a breaching licensee is not entitled to rely on the License or complain of any breach by the Licensor. This is operative legal material, but it cannot be faithfully represented as a rule over the supplied activities and objects; it remains unresolved.
Section 10.4 is jurisdiction-dependent; the applicable jurisdiction and any particular additional rights cannot be determined from this chunk.
